mapper.select: SELECT b.id AS budgetId, b.budget_type AS budgetType, b.category_name AS categoryName, b.member_user_id AS memberUserId, b.year_month AS yearMonth, b.budget_amount AS budgetAmount, b.warn_percent AS warnPercent, IFNULL(SUM(ABS(r.amount)), 0) AS spentAmount FROM tb_budget b LEFT JOIN tb_record_detail r ON r.record_book_id = b.record_book_id AND date_format(r.occur_time, '%Y-%m') = b.year_month AND r.audit_status = 2 AND r.amount < 0 AND r.delete_time IS NULL WHERE b.record_book_id = #{recordBookId} AND b.year_month = #{yearMonth} AND b.budget_type = 1 AND b.delete_time IS NULL GROUP BY b.id

SELECT b.id AS budgetId, b.budget_type AS budgetType, b.category_name AS categoryName, b.member_user_id AS memberUserId, b.year_month AS yearMonth, b.budget_amount AS budgetAmount, b.warn_percent AS warnPercent, IFNULL(SUM(ABS(r.amount)), 0) AS spentAmount FROM tb_budget b LEFT JOIN tb_record_detail r ON r.record_book_id = b.record_book_id AND date_format(r.occur_time, '%Y-%m') = b.year_month AND r.record_category = b.category_name AND r.audit_status = 2 AND r.amount < 0 AND r.delete_time IS NULL WHERE b.record_book_id = #{recordBookId} AND b.year_month = #{yearMonth} AND b.budget_type = 2 AND b.delete_time IS NULL GROUP BY b.id

SELECT b.id AS budgetId, b.budget_type AS budgetType, b.category_name AS categoryName, b.member_user_id AS memberUserId, u.nickname AS memberName, b.year_month AS yearMonth, b.budget_amount AS budgetAmount, b.warn_percent AS warnPercent, IFNULL(SUM(ABS(r.amount)), 0) AS spentAmount FROM tb_budget b LEFT JOIN tb_record_detail r ON r.record_book_id = b.record_book_id AND date_format(r.occur_time, '%Y-%m') = b.year_month AND r.user_id = b.member_user_id AND r.audit_status = 2 AND r.amount < 0 AND r.delete_time IS NULL LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.id = b.member_user_id WHERE b.record_book_id = #{recordBookId} AND b.year_month = #{yearMonth} AND b.budget_type = 3 AND b.delete_time IS NULL GROUP BY b.id
